from manim import *
import numpy as np

class WalkingAgent1(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        
        # Trackers
        t = ValueTracker(0) # For walk cycle and scroll
        blink = ValueTracker(1.0) # Eye Y scale
        mouth_open = ValueTracker(0.0) # 0 = smile, 1 = laugh
        
        # Stroke config
        s_width = 8
        s_color = BLACK
        
        # Scrolling background
        ground = Line(LEFT*10, RIGHT*10, color=BLACK, stroke_width=4).shift(DOWN*2.5)
        
        clouds = VGroup()
        for i in range(20):
            cloud = VGroup(
                Circle(0.5, color=BLACK, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1),
                Circle(0.7, color=BLACK, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1).shift(RIGHT*0.5+UP*0.2),
                Circle(0.4, color=BLACK, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1).shift(RIGHT*1.0+DOWN*0.1)
            ).set_stroke(width=3)
            cloud_base = Rectangle(width=1.5, height=0.5, color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1).move_to(cloud.get_bottom()+UP*0.25)
            cloud_line = Line(cloud.get_corner(DL), cloud.get_corner(DR), color=BLACK, stroke_width=3).move_to(cloud.get_bottom())
            final_cloud = VGroup(cloud, cloud_base, cloud_line).scale(0.8)
            final_cloud.shift(RIGHT * (i * 5 - 20) + UP * (1.5 + (i%3)*0.5))
            clouds.add(final_cloud)

        pebbles = VGroup()
        for i in range(50):
            pebble = Line(LEFT, RIGHT, color=BLACK, stroke_width=4).scale(np.random.uniform(0.1, 0.3))
            pebble.shift(RIGHT * (i * 2 - 20) + DOWN * 2.5)
            pebbles.add(pebble)

        def get_scrolling_bg():
            g = VGroup(clouds.copy(), pebbles.copy())
            # Ground moves at 2.4/PI speed to exactly match the feet
            g[0].shift(LEFT * (2.4 / PI) * t.get_value() * 0.5) # Clouds move slower (parallax)
            g[1].shift(LEFT * (2.4 / PI) * t.get_value())       # Ground moves at 1x speed
            return g
            
        bg_dyn = always_redraw(get_scrolling_bg)
        
        # Stickman generator
        def get_stickman():
            phi = t.get_value()
            bounce = 0.4 * abs(np.sin(phi))
            
            hips = np.array([-0.2, -1.2 + bounce, 0])
            neck = np.array([0.1, 0.5 + bounce, 0])
            head_c = np.array([0.2, 1.4 + bounce, 0])
            
            # Legs (math calculations for perfect lock)
            p1 = (phi / PI) % 2
            p2 = ((phi + PI) / PI) % 2
            
            def foot_x(p):
                if p < 1: return 1.2 - 2.4 * p
                else: return -1.2 + 2.4 * (p - 1)
                    
            def foot_y(p):
                if p < 1: return -2.5
                else: return -2.5 + 0.8 * np.sin((p - 1) * PI)
                    
            f1_x = foot_x(p1)
            f2_x = foot_x(p2)
            f1_y = foot_y(p1)
            f2_y = foot_y(p2)
            
            foot1 = np.array([f1_x, f1_y, 0])
            foot2 = np.array([f2_x, f2_y, 0])
            
            def get_knee(p_start, p_end, is_arm=False):
                dist = np.linalg.norm(p_end - p_start)
                max_len = 2.4 if not is_arm else 1.8
                bend_amount = np.sqrt(max(0.01, (max_len/2)**2 - (dist/2)**2))
                mid = (p_start + p_end) / 2
                vec = p_end - p_start
                if is_arm: normal = np.array([vec[1], -vec[0], 0])
                else: normal = np.array([-vec[1], vec[0], 0])
                normal = normal / (np.linalg.norm(normal) + 0.001)
                return mid + normal * bend_amount
                
            knee1 = get_knee(hips, foot1, is_arm=False)
            knee2 = get_knee(hips, foot2, is_arm=False)
            
            leg1 = VMobject().set_stroke(s_color, s_width)
            leg1.set_points_as_corners([hips, knee1, foot1])
            leg2 = VMobject().set_stroke(s_color, s_width)
            leg2.set_points_as_corners([hips, knee2, foot2])
            
            # Arms
            h1_x = 0.2 - 1.2 * np.cos(phi)
            h2_x = 0.2 - 1.2 * np.cos(phi + PI)
            h1_y = -0.5 + bounce + 0.3 * abs(np.cos(phi))
            h2_y = -0.5 + bounce + 0.3 * abs(np.cos(phi + PI))
            
            hand1 = np.array([h1_x, h1_y, 0])
            hand2 = np.array([h2_x, h2_y, 0])
            
            elbow1 = get_knee(neck, hand1, is_arm=True)
            elbow2 = get_knee(neck, hand2, is_arm=True)
            
            arm1 = VMobject().set_stroke(s_color, s_width)
            arm1.set_points_as_corners([neck, elbow1, hand1])
            arm2 = VMobject().set_stroke(s_color, s_width)
            arm2.set_points_as_corners([neck, elbow2, hand2])
            
            body = Line(hips, neck).set_stroke(s_color, s_width)
            
            # Head
            head = Circle(radius=0.7, color=s_color, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1).move_to(head_c).set_stroke(width=s_width)
            
            # Eyes
            eye_y = head_c[1] + 0.1
            eye_L = Dot(np.array([head_c[0] + 0.1, eye_y, 0]), radius=0.08, color=BLACK)
            eye_R = Dot(np.array([head_c[0] + 0.5, eye_y, 0]), radius=0.08, color=BLACK)
            
            b_val = blink.get_value()
            eye_L.stretch(max(0.01, b_val), dim=1)
            eye_R.stretch(max(0.01, b_val), dim=1)
            eyes = VGroup(eye_L, eye_R)
            
            # Mouth
            m_val = mouth_open.get_value()
            mouth_center = head_c + np.array([0.3, -0.2, 0])
            
            mouth = VMobject()
            p1 = mouth_center + np.array([-0.2, 0, 0])
            p5 = mouth_center + np.array([0.2, 0, 0])
            drop = 0.1 + 0.4 * m_val
            c1 = p1 + np.array([0, -drop*1.3, 0])
            c2 = p5 + np.array([0, -drop*1.3, 0])
            
            mouth.start_new_path(p1)
            mouth.add_cubic_bezier_curve_to(c1, c2, p5)
            mouth.add_line_to(p1)
            mouth.set_fill(BLACK, opacity=min(1.0, m_val*5))
            mouth.set_stroke(BLACK, width=(s_width-3)*(1 - min(1.0, m_val)))
                
            # Z-order: leg2, arm2 (back), body, head, leg1, arm1, eyes, mouth
            return VGroup(leg2, arm2, body, head, leg1, arm1, eyes, mouth)
            
        agent = always_redraw(get_stickman)
        
        self.add(ground, bg_dyn, agent)
        
        # Animations
        # 6 seconds run time, we'll walk 4 full cycles (4 * 2 * PI)
        # So frequency is 4 cycles / 6 seconds = 0.66 Hz. This is a brisk, peppy walk.
        walk_anim = t.animate.set_value(4 * 2 * PI)
        
        # Blinks (quick 0.1s down, 0.1s up)
        def blink_anim(start_time):
            return Succession(
                Wait(start_time),
                blink.animate(run_time=0.1).set_value(0.1),
                blink.animate(run_time=0.1).set_value(1.0),
            )
            
        b1 = blink_anim(1.0)
        b2 = blink_anim(2.5)
        b3 = blink_anim(4.0)
        
        # Smile to Laugh at t=2.0
        laugh_anim = Succession(
            Wait(2.0),
            mouth_open.animate(run_time=1.0).set_value(1.0),
        )
        
        self.play(
            walk_anim,
            b1, b2, b3,
            laugh_anim,
            run_time=6,
            rate_func=linear
        )
        self.wait(1)
